End date: Only for a run of dates, like tech week
Title: Shown in bold
Performance: Yes = coral show date, also listed on the Shows page
Track: Only if double cast: a track name from the website settings
Notes: One per line (Ctrl+Enter). A line that is just a time, like 2:00-3:30pm, becomes a heading
Cast needed: Roles with commas, e.g. Ariel, Gulls. Or All, or None. Blank = not posted yet
Study hall volunteer: Parent's name. Or Needed for a sign-up link. Blank = no study hall line
